Interface PositionPath

All Known Implementing Classes:
PositionPath.Linear, PositionPath.Stepped
public sealed interface PositionPath permits PositionPath.Linear, PositionPath.Stepped
An absolute path an entity follows, either a single destination or a series of timed waypoints. Positions are full precision, so unlike VecDelta a path covers any distance and does not depend on the receiver agreeing about where the entity was.

Both the variant and the waypoint count travel in the payload, so a path reads on its own, where a delta has to be told its step count by the packet carrying it.
